```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  cache = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  cache.comments = FALSE

```

```{r prep-data, cache = FALSE}
### Load packages
library(brms)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidybayes)
library(patchwork)
library(rstan)

### Load custom functions
source("functions.R")

### Load clean and prepped data
source("data_prep.R")

```

# Analysis

## Vertical lobe

### Habitat and depth
```{r noPhy-m1VL}
f <- bf(VL.1 ~ mi(ML.1) + CNS.1 + depth.max*benthic + WoS) +
     bf(ML.1 | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1)

m1.VL <- brms_func(f)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1.VL, effects = "depth.max:benthic", resp = "VL1"), points = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1.VL, effects = "benthic", resp = "VL1"), points = TRUE)
```

### Depth categories
```{r noPhy-m1cVL}
f <- bf(VL.1 ~ mi(ML.1) + CNS.1 + depth_cat + WoS) +
     bf(ML.1 | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1 + depth_cat)

m1c.VL <- brms_func(f)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1c.VL, effects = "depth_cat", resp = "VL1"), points = TRUE, plot = FALSE)[[1]] +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=(c("shallow", "daily", "ontogenetic", "deep")))
```

```{r fnoPhy-m1cVL, dpi=600, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# depth categories
mod <- m1c.VL
imp <- mod$data
resp <- "VL1"
y_var <- sub("(\\D)(\\d+)", "\\1.\\2", resp)

expand.grid(list(depth_cat = 1:4)) |>
  mutate(ML.1 = 0, CNS.1 = 0, WoS = 0) |> # set covariates to their means
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  gdensity_plot(x_var = depth_cat, 
           y_var = !!sym(y_var),
           data = imp) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cat4_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cat4_colors) +
  labs(x = "Depth category", y = "Vertical lobe size") +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("shallow", "daily\n migration", "ontogenetic\n migration", "deep")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


### Age of sexual maturity
```{r noPhy-m2VL}
f <- bf(VL.1 ~ mi(ML.1) + CNS.1 + mi(lifespan.max) + mi(matage.max) + WoS + benthic + depth.mean) + 
     bf(matage.max | mi() ~ 1 + mi(ML.1) + mi(lifespan.max) + WoS + benthic + depth.mean) + 
     bf(lifespan.max | mi() ~ 1 + mi(ML.1) + WoS + benthic + depth.mean) + 
     bf(ML.1 | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1 + benthic + depth.mean)

m2.VL <- brms_func(f)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m2.VL, effects = "matage.max", resp = "VL1"), points = TRUE)
```

### Sociality
```{r noPhy-m3VL}
f <- bf(VL.1 ~ mi(ML.1) + CNS.1 + sociality.bin + WoS + benthic + depth.mean) + 
     bf(ML.1 | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1 + benthic + depth.mean)

m3.VL <- brms_func(f)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m3.VL, effects = "sociality.bin", resp = "VL1"), points = TRUE)
```

### Defense
```{r noPhy-m4VL}
f <- bf(VL.1 ~ mi(ML.1) + CNS.1 +  mi(defense.repertoire)*benthic + articles.read + depth.mean + pos.latmean) +
     bf(ML.1 | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1 + benthic + depth.mean + pos.latmean)+
     bf(defense.repertoire | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1 + benthic + articles.read)

m4.VL <- brms_func(f, constrain_imp = TRUE, vars = "defense.repertoire")
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m4.VL, effects = "defense.repertoire:benthic", resp = "VL1"), points = TRUE)
```

### Biolumninescence (NB: only relevant for the optic lobe)

```{r noPhy-m8OPL}
f <- bf(OPL.1 ~ mi(ML.1) + CNS.1 + biolum*depth_cat) +
     bf(ML.1 | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1)

m8.OPL.nophy <- brms_func(f)
```

```{r fnoPhy-m8OPL, dpi=600, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# depth X biolum interaction
mod <- m8.OPL.nophy
imp <- impute(model = mod, var = c("ML.1")) # impute to plot points
resp <- "OPL1"
y_var <- sub("(\\D)(\\d+)", "\\1.\\2", resp)

(f.bl <- expand.grid(list(depth_cat = 1:4, biolum = 0:1)) |>
  mutate(ML.1 = 0, CNS.1 = 0) |> # set covariates to their means
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  cat_plot(x_var = depth_cat, 
           y_var = !!sym(y_var),
           g_var = biolum,
           data = imp,
           interaction = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Depth category", y = "Optic lobe size")  +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Bioluminescence",
                     values = c("0" = cat_colors[1], "1" = cat_colors[2]),
                     labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Bioluminescence",
                     values = c("0" = cat_colors[1], "1" = cat_colors[2]),
                     labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("shallow", "daily\n migration", "ontogenetic\n migration", "deep")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
```

```{r noPhy-m8OPL-lsmeans}
# posterior contrasts/marginal mean differences (depth_cat by biolum)
expand.grid(list(depth_cat = as.factor(1:4), biolum = as.factor(0:1))) |>
  mutate(ML.1 = 0, CNS.1 = 0) |> 
  as.data.frame() |>
  marginaleffects::avg_comparisons(model = mod, 
                                   variables = "depth_cat", 
                                   by = "biolum", 
                                   re_formula = NA, 
                                   resp = resp)

# posterior contrasts/marginal mean differences (biolum by depth_cat)
expand.grid(list(depth_cat = as.factor(1:4), biolum = as.factor(0:1))) |>
  mutate(ML.1 = 0, CNS.1 = 0) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  marginaleffects::avg_comparisons(model = mod, 
                                   variables = "biolum",
                                   by = "depth_cat",
                                   re_formula = NA, 
                                   resp = resp)
```

```{r noPhy-m4avgCNS}
     bf(avgML | mi() ~ 1 + benthic + depth.mean + pos.latmean)+
     bf(defense.repertoire | mi() ~ 1 + benthic + articles.read)

m4.avgCNS <- brms_func(f, constrain_imp = TRUE, vars = "defense.repertoire")
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m4.avgCNS, effects = "defense.repertoire:benthic", resp = "avgCNS"), points = TRUE)
```

## Vertical lobe complex

### Habitat and depth
```{r noPhy-m1VLC}
f <- bf(VLC.1 ~ mi(ML.1) + CNS.1 + depth.max*benthic + WoS) +
  bf(ML.1 | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1)

m1.VLC <- brms_func(f)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1.VLC, effects = "depth.max:benthic", resp = "VLC1"), points = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1.VLC, effects = "benthic", resp = "VLC1"), points = TRUE)
```

### Depth categories
```{r noPhy-m1cVLC}
f <- bf(VLC.1 ~ mi(ML.1) + CNS.1 + depth_cat + WoS) +
  bf(ML.1 | mi() ~ 1 + CNS.1 + depth_cat)

m1c.VLC <- brms_func(f)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(m1c.VLC, effects = "depth_cat", resp = "VLC1"), points = TRUE, plot = FALSE)[[1]] +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=(c("shallow", "daily", "ontogenetic", "deep")))
```

```{r fnoPhy-m1cVLC, dpi=600, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# depth categories
mod <- m1c.VLC
imp <- mod$data
resp <- "VLC1"
y_var <- sub("(\\D)(\\d+)", "\\1.\\2", resp)

expand.grid(list(depth_cat = 1:4)) |>
  mutate(ML.1 = 0, CNS.1 = 0, WoS = 0) |> # set covariates to their means
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  gdensity_plot(x_var = depth_cat, 
           y_var = !!sym(y_var),
           data = imp) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cat4_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cat4_colors) +
  labs(x = "Depth category", y = "Vertical lobe complex size") +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("shallow", "daily\n migration", "ontogenetic\n migration", "deep")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Report plots

## Panel: VL

```{r}
# depth X benthic interaction
mod <- m1.VL
imp <- mod$data
resp <- "VL1"
y_var <- sub("(\\D)(\\d+)", "\\1.\\2", resp)

f.db <- expand.grid(list(depth.max = -4:2, benthic = 0:1)) |>
  mutate(ML.1 = 0, WoS = 0, CNS.1 = 0) |> # set covariates to their means
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  lineribbon_plot(x_var = depth.max, 
                  y_var = !!sym(y_var), 
                  data = imp,
                  interaction = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Maximum depth", y = "Vertical lobe size") 

### benthic  
f.b <- rbind(transform(imp, benthic = 0),
             transform(imp, benthic = 1)) |>
  mutate(ML.1 = 0, WoS = 0, CNS.1 = 0, benthic = as.factor(benthic)) |> 
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  gdensity_plot(x_var = benthic, 
           y_var = !!sym(y_var), 
           data = imp) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("pelagic", "benthic")) + 
  labs(x = "Habitat", y = "Vertical lobe size")  

### age of sexual maturity

imp <- impute(model = mod, var = c("ML.1", "matage.max")) # impute to plot points

  mutate(ML.1 = 0, 
         lifespan.max = 0, 
         CNS.1 = 0, 
         WoS = 0, 
         depth.mean = 0,
         benthic = 0) |>
  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  lineribbon_plot(x_var = matage.max, 
                  y_var = !!sym(y_var), 
                  data = imp,
                  interaction = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Maximum age of sexual maturity", y = "Vertical lobe size")

             transform(imp, sociality.bin = 1)) |>

  add_epred_draws(mod, resp = resp, re_formula = NA) |>
  gdensity_plot(x_var = sociality.bin, 
           y_var = !!sym(y_var), 
           data = imp) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("solitary", "gregarious")) + 
  labs(x = "Sociality", y = "Vertical lobe size")

  lineribbon_plot(x_var = defense.repertoire, 
                  y_var = !!sym(y_var),
```

```{r prepforest}
### No phylo

predbenth.avgCNS.phy <- fixef(m6.avgCNS, pars = "avgCNS_mipredator.breadth:benthic1")
predbenth.VLC.phy <- fixef(m6.VLC, pars = "VLC1_mipredator.breadth:benthic1")

# Phylo: Foraging
diet.VL.phy <- fixef(m7.VL, pars = "VL1_midiet.breadth")
diet.OPL.phy <- fixef(m7.OPL, pars = "OPL1_midiet.breadth")
diet.CC.phy <- fixef(m7.CC, pars = "CC1_midiet.breadth")
diet.avgCNS.phy <- fixef(m7.avgCNS, pars = "avgCNS_midiet.breadth")
diet.VLC.phy <- fixef(m7.VLC, pars = "VLC1_midiet.breadth")

# Phylo: Foraging
```

```{r setupforest, dependson="collectforest"}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidybayes)

### plotting colors
colors <- c("blue", "black")

### define factor levels for plotting
forestPhylo$predictor <- factor(forestPhylo$predictor,
                                levels=c("Depth",
                                         "Benthic",
                                         "Depth:Benthic",
                                         "Maturity",
                                         "Sociality",
                                         "Defense",
                                         "Defense:Benthic",
                                         "Foraging",
                                         "Foraging:Benthic",
                                         "Predatory breadth",
                                         "Predatory breadth:Benthic",
                                         "Diet breadth",
                                         "Diet breadth:Benthic")) |> forcats::fct_rev()

forestPhylo$phylo <- factor(forestPhylo$phylo,
                                levels=c("With phylogeny",
                                         "No phylogeny"))
```

## VL

```{r fVLphyforest, fig.height=7, dpi = 600, fig.width=8, dependson="setupforest"}
### VL
forestPhylo |>
  filter(lobe == "VL") |>
  ggplot(aes(y = predictor)) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = est, xmin = lower, xmax = upper, color = phylo),
                  position = position_dodge(width = -0.6),
                     point_size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(title = "Vertical lobe",
       subtitle = "Comparing models with and without phylogeny",
       x = "Relationship with vertical lobe",
       y = "Predictor") + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```
